summary: West Papua independence commemoration is explicitly tied to 1 December 1961; recurrence in other places or continuity into adjacent months has not been checked.

episode_anchor.value: Article quotes organizers linking the action to the 1 Dec declaration commemoration.

related_multi_city_reporting.value: Indoleft, translating/abridging an Arah Juang report, names Dec 1 actions in Jakarta, Yogyakarta, Ternate and Sinjai; this is not independent of Arah Juang and does not establish Surabaya continuity.
